title: Photo to Japanese Flat Poster
summary: Turn a person or pet photo into a Japanese-style flat illustration poster with screen-print grain, an overhead viewpoint, and generous negative space, while keeping the subject recognizable.
seoTitle: Photo to Japanese Flat Illustration Poster Prompt | Image Prompt Book
seoDescription: Transform a person or pet photo into a grainy Japanese-style flat poster. Compare two source examples, adjust subject focus and colors, then copy the complete prompt.
inputRequirement: Requires one photo containing a person, cat, dog, or another animal. Attach it in your image generation tool before sending the prompt.
howToUse: Choose the subject focus and palette, or keep the source defaults.
Copy the complete prompt or open it in ChatGPT.
Attach your photo and send. The prompt requests a 3:4 portrait diptych, with the original subject above and its flat illustration below.
exampleNotice: Two photo-to-illustration comparisons from the author: a Shiba Inu and a coastal portrait. Drag the divider to compare each pair.
